## Experience
- Current: Full Stack Engineer at OnFinance AI (Nov 2024–Present). Built the entire frontend from scratch with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind. Optimized MongoDB analytics APIs on 300k+ records, cutting dashboard load times from 4.5–6 min to 15–30 sec (30x improvement). Migrated agent architecture to a Deep Agents framework, reducing deployment time by 70% and consolidating 47 tools into 8 reusable sub-agents. Supported a $4.2M pre-Series A round from PeakXV Partners.
- Past: Backend Engineering Intern at Wokelo AI (Feb–Jul 2024). Built FastAPI + Python pipelines for structured financial data extraction from PDFs using CV and NLP. Improved LinkedIn profile validation accuracy from ~20% to 90%+. Fine-tuned Meta LLaMA-3 for internal automation workflows and built DOCX/PPTX report generation pipelines.
- Past: AI Systems / Full Stack Consultant for a Confidential U.S. Client. Co-built a production-ready AI compliance validation platform MVP in 10 days — covering regulation ingestion, reviewer workflows, real-time violation surfacing, and PDF audit reporting.

- AI Compliance Platform (Confidential): Real-time AI agent conversation compliance validator with turn-by-turn violation detection, Qdrant vector indexing, and WebSocket flag streaming — MVP shipped in 10 days.
